schema: everything ingested into the project, what it contained, and what it changed. append only.

documents.name: Iowa Survey Draft.xlsx
documents.contained: Property address, city, acreage, distance to transmission line, distance to substation, wetland notes, FEMA flood zone, listing agent and contact.
documents.gaps: No parcel IDs, no county, no submarket, no zoning, no owner names.

documents.name: CoStar Sites - IA.xlsx
documents.contained: Three stacked blocks — a CoStar export across 23 columns, LandWatch results with acreage and hydrology, and Land.com auction listings.
documents.gaps: The CoStar block carried Energy Star and LEED columns but no acreage or lot size, leaving five records unscoreable. One tract duplicated a record already present from the survey draft.

documents.name: USDA 2022 Census of Agriculture — Iowa county tables
documents.contained: Farms, land in farms, average and median farm size, and farms-by-size brackets for every Iowa county.
documents.yielded: Median farm size by county, which makes owners-per-section computable
documents.gaps: Counts operations rather than ownerships, so owners-per-section is an optimistic floor until calibrated against a real parcel dissolve.

documents.name: Book1 (1).xlsx
documents.contained: Firm, person called, number, result, date and notes across five brokerage contacts made on 5 August.
documents.gaps: No follow-up dates recorded, and the 2,700+ acre figure against Iowa Farmland has no location, parcel count or owner attached.

documents.name: farmlandsaleprospect.zip
documents.contained: Aerial map PDF for Sec 16-92N-36W, Buena Vista County, plus three FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer screenshots centred on 42.782743, -95.100688.
documents.yielded: Flood exposure on S-018 quantified as Zone A
documents.gaps: No parcel ID, no owner name, no survey, and no delineated buildable acreage. Zone A carries no Base Flood Elevation, so the flood depth is unknown.

documents.name: Book1 (2).xlsx
documents.contained: The running call log, extended to seven rows with two new conversations on 12 August.
documents.gaps: Row six carries no firm, no person and no number, yet produced the November auction book and the Emmet County lead. One email address is incomplete.

documents.name: Iowa_County_Data_Center_Screen.xlsx
documents.contained: Five sheets. All 99 counties with farmland price per acre, CSR2, political lean, data-centre posture, moratorium status, utility, grid and water notes and existing projects; plus project pipeline, moratorium tracker, state policy and a sources tab.
documents.yielded: Price, water and posture across the screen; one correction; one new county
documents.gaps: CSR2 is ISPAID-derived and published by crop reporting district rather than by county, so it is directional. Posture for 80 of 99 counties is 'neutral-no record', which means nothing has been proposed, not that the county is receptive.

how_to_add: Send any file — spreadsheet, PDF, notes, call log, parcel export, photos of a plat book page. It gets normalised into the schema, appended, and pushed. The site updates in about thirty seconds and the analysis re-runs against the new totals.
